## Problem / 想解决的问题

<!-- What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way? / 你在什么场景下遇到了什么不便？ -->

## Proposed solution / 期望的做法

<!-- How should MailX behave? / 你希望 MailX 怎样表现？ -->

## Alternatives considered / 考虑过的替代方案

## Additional context / 补充信息

<!-- Platforms, providers or MCP clients involved; how other mail clients handle it. / 涉及的平台、服务商、MCP 客户端，或其他邮件客户端的参考做法。 -->
